resources.string: Option B (e.g. Launch my own venture)
Place your right index finger gently over the rear camera and flash.
Calibrating resting nervous system… take one slow, deep breath.
Keep your finger still. Look at the center of the screen.
WITHUS Choose uses the camera and LED flash to detect subtle blood pulse changes in your fingertip (Photoplethysmography) to calibrate your resting heart rate.
